[[Garbok's Chalice]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Garbok Handsmasher]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Inspiration Magic +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:Halves skill recharge of Inspiration Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, because it effectively has two inscriptions: [["Master of My Domain"]] and [["Forget Me Not"]].
